# Function-local declarations exercise the installed default validator.
# Their scope excludes generated serialization methods and constructors.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Accepted controls cover numeric boundaries, composite keys and blank fields.
logos build -o $WORK/control.exe ./control

# The default is checked in its declaration's file or local scope.
logos build -o $WORK/imported.exe ./imported
logos build -o $WORK/local.exe ./local

# Every invalid declaration must fail without constructing its type.
! logos build -o $WORK/overflow-low.exe ./overflow_low
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*overflows'
! logos build -o $WORK/overflow-high.exe ./overflow_high
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*overflows'
! logos build -o $WORK/scalar.exe ./scalar
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/composite.exe ./composite
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/map-key.exe ./map_key
stderr 'bad.lgo:5:[0-9]+:.*\[correctness::default_not_constant\]'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank.exe ./blank
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank-defaults.exe ./blank_defaults
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'
! logos build -o $WORK/blank-group.exe ./blank_group
stderr 'bad.lgo:3:[0-9]+:.*cannot use'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/defaultvalidation

go 1.27
-- control/main.lgo --
package main

func unused() {
	type Bounds struct {
		Zero      uint8 = 0
		One       uint8 = 1
		BeforeMax uint8 = 254
		Max       uint8 = 255
	}
	type Composites struct {
		Numbers []int = []int{1, 2}
		Fields struct { N int } = struct { N int }{N: 1}
		Table map[int]string = map[int]string{1: "ok"}
	}
	type BlankAfter struct { _ int; _ string = "ok" }
	type BlankDefaults struct { _ int = 1; _ string = "ok" }
	type BlankGroup struct { _ int; _, Value string = "ok" }
	type BlankTail struct { _ int; Value, _ string = "ok" }
}

func main() {}
-- imported/main.lgo --
package main

import "time"

func unused() { type Unused struct { Delay time.Duration = time.Second } }

func main() {}
-- local/main.lgo --
package main

func unused() {
	const local = 17
	type Unused struct { Value int = local }
}

func main() {}
-- overflow_low/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value uint8 = -1 } }

func main() {}
-- overflow_high/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value uint8 = 256 } }

func main() {}
-- scalar/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- composite/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { Value []int = []string{"bad"} } }

func main() {}
-- map_key/bad.lgo --
package main

var calls int
func key() int { calls++; return calls }
func unused() { type Unused struct { Value map[int]int = map[int]int{key(): 1} } }

func main() {}
-- blank/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string; _ int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- blank_defaults/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string = "first"; _ int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
-- blank_group/bad.lgo --
package main

func unused() { type Unused struct { _ string; _, Value int = "bad" } }

func main() {}
